disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件全部凭据读取路径：只经宿主标准凭据接口解析链路鉴权用的共享密钥（DSH_INTERCONNECT_TOKEN），用于入站与出站鉴权；未发现枚举用户其他凭据（云厂商密钥、SSH 私钥、钱包助记词等）的代码，也未发现硬编码密钥。README 中提及凭据文件（机械命中规则 DSH-C01/DG-R1-51）仅为安装文档，教用户在凭据文件里配置共享密钥，不是读取凭据的代码，判定为良性文档引用。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all credential reading paths in the plugin: it reads only the shared secret (DSH_INTERCONNECT_TOKEN) used for link authentication through the host's standard credential interface, for both inbound and outbound authentication; no code was found that enumerates other user credentials (cloud provider keys, SSH private keys, wallet mnemonics, etc.), and no hardcoded keys were found. The credential file mention in the README (mechanical hit rules DSH-C01/DG-R1-51) is only installation documentation, teaching users to configure the shared secret in a credential file; it is not code that reads credentials, so it is judged as a benign documentation reference.

checked_items.zh: 检查了敏感路径访问（SSH 目录、云凭据文件、各类密钥文件），未发现任何读取。
checked_items.en: Checked sensitive path access (SSH directory, cloud credential files, various key files); no reads were found.

evidence.zh: 插件只经标准凭据接口读取自身链路鉴权用的共享密钥，出站仅拨号到用户显式配置的对端并以该密钥鉴权，不存在读取用户其他凭据后外发的通道。
evidence.en: The plugin reads only the shared secret used for its own link authentication through the standard credential interface. Outbound traffic dials only the peers explicitly configured by the user and authenticates with that secret; there is no channel for exfiltrating other user credentials after reading them.

checked_items.zh: 逐条审查了插件注册的四个模型可见工具（发送消息、探测对端、列出会话、回复消息）的描述与参数说明，均为功能说明，未发现伪装指令、系统消息伪装、凭证读取诱导、安装或改配置诱导等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the descriptions and parameter documentation of the four model-visible tools registered by the plugin (send message, probe peer, list sessions, reply message) one by one; all are functional descriptions. No injection wording was found such as disguised instructions, system message impersonation, credential-reading inducement, or install/config-change inducement.

checked_items.zh: 检查了仓库内是否存在代理指令文件（如 AGENTS.md、SKILL.md 等）或向系统提示注入内容的调用，未发现。对端经共享密钥鉴权后可向本机 live 会话投递文本，接收方模型将其作为用户消息处理——这是插件声明的跨实例消息功能，信任边界是共享密钥与显式对端配置，未发现超出该功能的注入面。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the repository contains proxy instruction files (e.g., AGENTS.md, SKILL.md) or calls that inject content into the system prompt; none found. A peer authenticated via the shared secret can deliver text to a live session on this machine, and the receiving model treats it as a user message — this is the cross-instance messaging feature declared by the plugin. The trust boundary is the shared secret and the explicitly configured peers; no injection surface beyond that feature was found.

evidence.zh: 工具描述为纯功能说明，不含任何指令性内容，也未向系统提示注入片段。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions are purely functional, contain no instructional content, and do not inject fragments into the system prompt.

evidence.zh: 工具描述不包含诱导安装插件、改写配置、放开权限等措辞，模型可见面无法触发安装或配置变更行为。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions do not contain wording that induces plugin installation, config modification, or permission escalation; the model-visible surface cannot trigger installation or config-change behavior.

checked_items.zh: 扫描全部源码未发现动态代码执行（eval、动态函数构造）与运行时子进程调用。唯一子进程调用位于构建脚本（机械命中规则 DSH-X03/DG-R3-55），仅用于调用 TypeScript 编译器生成类型声明；该构建脚本不在发布清单内（发布只含 lib、挂载配置、插件声明、README、LICENSE），判定为良性工程惯例。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code; no dynamic code execution (eval, dynamic function construction) or runtime subprocess invocation was found. The only subprocess invocation is in a build script (mechanical hit rules DSH-X03/DG-R3-55), used solely to invoke the TypeScript compiler to generate type declarations; that build script is not in the release manifest (the release contains only lib, the patch config, the plugin manifest, README, LICENSE), so it is judged as a benign engineering practice.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载配置（cordis.patch.yml）：无任何可执行 YAML 标签（规则 DSH-P01 检查），仅插入两个插件行，无执行面。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch config (cordis.patch.yml): no executable YAML tags (checked by rule DSH-P01); it only inserts two plugin lines, no execution surface.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 GitHub Actions 工作流（机械命中规则 DSH-X07/DG-R3-59）：标准 CI，拉取官方 DSH 仓库、安装依赖、跑类型检查与测试，无下载执行远程载荷、无凭据外发等恶意内容，判定为良性。
checked_items.en: Checked the GitHub Actions workflow (mechanical hit rules DSH-X07/DG-R3-59): standard CI that fetches the official DSH repository, installs dependencies, runs type checks and tests; no downloading and executing of remote payloads, no credential exfiltration, or other malicious content — judged benign.

evidence.zh: 全部 YAML 配置均未发现可执行标签（!!js），挂载配置仅插入两个插件行，无补丁即执行代码的面。
evidence.en: No executable tags (!!js) were found in any YAML configuration; the patch config only inserts two plugin lines, with no patch-to-code-execution surface.

evidence.zh: 插件未调用让模型在宿主执行动态代码的工具（如 cordis_define/cordis_run），模型可见能力仅限于发送文本消息，无自修改执行面。
evidence.en: The plugin does not call tools that let the model execute dynamic code on the host (e.g., cordis_define/cordis_run); the model-visible capabilities are limited to sending text messages, with no self-modifying execution surface.

evidence.zh: 发布清单无安装钩子（preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare 均不存在），仓库内除良性 CI 工作流外无其他执行载体（无 husky、devcontainer、Makefile、gitmodules）。
evidence.en: The release manifest has no install hooks (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare are all absent); apart from the benign CI workflow, there are no other execution carriers in the repository (no husky, devcontainer, Makefile, or gitmodules).

evidence.zh: 插件未声明浏览器端 client 模块（dsh.client），无自动加载的浏览器脚本。
evidence.en: The plugin does not declare a browser-side client module (dsh.client), and there is no auto-loaded browser script.

checked_items.zh: 审查了全部网络出口：出站仅对用户配置的对端（peers 映射）建立 WebSocket 链路并携带共享密钥鉴权；未发现硬编码域名、裸 IP、隧道、粘贴服务等可疑外联目标。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all network egress: outbound traffic only establishes WebSocket links to user-configured peers (peers mapping) with shared-secret authentication; no suspicious outbound targets were found such as hardcoded domains, bare IPs, tunnels, or paste services.

checked_items.zh: 检查了线上数据流：传输内容仅为业务消息与生命周期事件（会话状态、创建/销毁等），无读取敏感文件后外发的链路，无带外通道。
checked_items.en: Checked the online data flow: the transmitted content is only business messages and lifecycle events (session state, create/destroy, etc.); there is no chain that reads sensitive files and exfiltrates them, and no out-of-band channel.

evidence.zh: 出站仅拨号到用户显式配置的对端并以共享密钥鉴权，无凭据外发通道；插件读取的唯一凭据就是自身链路鉴权用的共享密钥。
evidence.en: Outbound traffic only dials peers explicitly configured by the user and authenticates with the shared secret; there is no credential exfiltration channel. The only credential the plugin reads is the shared secret used for its own link authentication.

checked_items.zh: 核对依赖清单：运行时依赖均为 DSH 官方包与 ws，未发现拼写仿冒、可疑包或浮动 git 引用（发布包不含 git 依赖，开发期依赖指向本地兄弟目录）。
checked_items.en: Checked the dependency manifest: runtime dependencies are all official DSH packages and ws; no typo-squatting, suspicious packages, or floating git references were found (the published package contains no git dependencies, and development-time dependencies point to a local sibling directory).

checked_items.zh: 核对挂载配置：仅插入两个插件行，未触碰沙箱/审批/权限配置行，未禁用安全配置，未改写注入/拦截配置。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch config: it only inserts two plugin lines, does not touch sandbox/approval/permission config lines, does not disable security configuration, and does not rewrite injection/interception config.

checked_items.zh: 检查安装钩子与作者身份：无安装期脚本；作者为个人账号，无伪装官方品牌的迹象。
checked_items.en: Checked install hooks and author identity: no install-time scripts; the author is a personal account with no sign of impersonating an official brand.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅插入插件行，未覆盖或禁用任何沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行。
evidence.en: The patch config only inserts plugin lines; it does not overwrite or disable any security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions.

evidence.zh: 插件未以高优先级监听工具执行前、审批请求等安全事件，不存在截断审批链的可能。
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen at high priority to security events such as pre-tool-execution or approval requests, so there is no possibility of truncating the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无上一版本基线，无法比对清单声明突变（升级自动激活）。
evidence.en: First audit with no previous version baseline, so manifest-declaration mutations cannot be compared (upgrade auto-activation).

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入/拦截配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务致其挂起的面。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite injection/interception configuration, so there is no surface for appending required services to a security plugin to make it hang.

checked_items.zh: 检查插件是否启动独立网络服务：未监听端口，仅在宿主 Web 服务器的 WebSocket 升级路由注册了带共享密钥鉴权的端点（未配置令牌时拒绝连接、令牌比较为恒等时间比较），未给宿主增加无鉴权 RPC 面。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts a standalone network service: it does not listen on any port; it only registers an endpoint on the host web server's WebSocket upgrade route with shared-secret authentication (connections are refused without a configured token, and token comparison is constant-time), so it does not add an unauthenticated RPC surface to the host.

checked_items.zh: 接收方默认允许已鉴权对端请求唤醒离线会话（会触发一次带完整工具集的模型回合）；该能力在文档中设计为发送方显式请求、接收方可配置关闭，属声明业务内的能力，无恶意证据。
checked_items.en: The receiving side by default allows an authenticated peer to request waking an offline session (which triggers one model turn with the full toolset); this capability is designed in the documentation as an explicit sender request and can be disabled by the receiver's configuration. It is a capability within the declared business scope, with no malicious evidence.

checked_items.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证，运行时行为基于静态分析。
checked_items.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed; runtime behavior is based on static analysis.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动 Web 服务；其注册的 WebSocket 端点有共享密钥鉴权，不构成无认证 RPC 面；宿主自身的无认证边界属生态固有风险，与本插件无直接关系。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service; its registered WebSocket endpoint has shared-secret authentication and does not constitute an unauthenticated RPC surface. The host's own unauthenticated boundary is an inherent ecosystem risk and is not directly related to this plugin.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核对完成：bundle 声明、插件清单、作者与依赖信息无异常。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification complete: bundle declaration, plugin manifest, author, and dependency information show no anomalies.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：未发现代码执行、凭据窃取、外联等恶意模式；机械命中的 3 条均经人工裁决为良性。
summary.en: Static scan complete: no malicious patterns such as code execution, credential theft, or outbound connections were found; all 3 mechanical hits were manually adjudicated as benign.

summary.zh: 行为分析完成：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无敏感文件读取路径，网络出口仅限用户配置的对端。
summary.en: Behavior analysis complete: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no sensitive-file read paths, and network egress is limited to user-configured peers.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查完成：工具描述与模型可见面无注入内容，能力声明与实测一致。
summary.en: AI metadata review complete: tool descriptions and the model-visible surface contain no injection content, and capability declarations match observed behavior.

summary.zh: 本任务未启用动态沙箱验证，动态层无证据。
summary.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not enabled for this task; no evidence at the dynamic layer.

target.zh: dsh-interconnect@0.9.0#32ca0ec0 完整审计（full，仓库根，无版本基线）
target.en: dsh-interconnect@0.9.0#32ca0ec0 full audit (full, repository root, no version baseline)

limits.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（L4 未启用），运行时行为基于静态分析。开发期依赖通过 link:../dsh 指向兄弟目录，审计未核验该兄弟目录内容（不随发布包分发）。插件清单文件 dsh.plugin.json 内 version 字段为 0.1.0，与 package.json 及任务卡的 0.9.0 不一致，报告以任务卡为准，不影响审计结论。
limits.en: No dynamic sandbox verification (L4 not enabled); runtime behavior is based on static analysis. Development-time dependencies point to a sibling directory via link:../dsh, and the audit did not verify that sibling directory's contents (not distributed with the release package). The version field in the plugin manifest file dsh.plugin.json is 0.1.0, which differs from the 0.9.0 in package.json and the task card; the report uses the task card version, which does not affect the audit conclusion.
